mentions.name: Gatana
mentions.description: This platform securely connects an organization's AI agents to their services, with flexible credential management and federated IDP trust. Ongoing work includes reducing dependency on US providers toward a fully EU-based stack, tool output compression with semantic search powered by a local model on Hetzner, a firewall for tool calls, and secure AI sandboxes ('OpenClaw but secure') integrated with the credential system.
mentions.audience: Organizations connecting their AI agents to services
mentions.source_excerpt: Building Gatana, a platform for securely connecting an organizations agents to their services, with very flexible credential management and federated IDP trust.

mentions.name: MCP Gateway
mentions.description: An MCP Gateway that centralizes access to MCP servers so organizations can use AI agents throughout the company. It provides centralized governance and security using per-user credentials provisioned out-of-band through the MCP protocol: it generates a one-time link that the end user can use to sign in to the underlying MCP server with OAuth or provide an API key.
mentions.problem: Clients wanted to use AI agents throughout their organization but had no centralized governance or security concepts for that access.
mentions.audience: Organizations that want to use AI agents across the company
